parameters.name: supplier_set
parameters.description: Finite supplier set containing the suppliers A, B, and C

parameters.name: num_suppliers
parameters.description: Number of suppliers in the supplier set

parameters.name: order_cost
parameters.description: Cost per order for each supplier

parameters.name: tables_per_order
parameters.description: Number of tables obtained per order from each supplier

parameters.name: min_tables_if_a_used_and_b_required
parameters.description: Minimum number of tables supplier B must provide if supplier A is used

variables.name: orders_by_supplier
variables.description: Nonnegative integer number of orders placed with each supplier

variables.name: supplier_usage
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if the corresponding supplier is used, otherwise 0

variables.name: tables_by_supplier
variables.description: Total number of tables procured from each supplier

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_orders
constraints.description: Order counts are nonnegative integers for each supplier

constraints.name: binary_supplier_usage
constraints.description: Supplier usage indicators are binary for each supplier

constraints.name: nonnegative_tables_by_supplier
constraints.description: Tables procured from each supplier are nonnegative

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_tables
constraints.description: Total tables procured across all suppliers are nonnegative

constraints.name: total_tables_bounds
constraints.description: Total tables procured must stay within the minimum and maximum demand limits

constraints.name: supplier_tables_from_orders
constraints.description: Tables obtained from each supplier are determined exactly by the supplier order count and lot size.

constraints.name: supplier_a_triggers_b_minimum_quantity
constraints.description: If supplier A is used, supplier B must provide at least the specified minimum number of tables.

constraints.name: supplier_b_implies_supplier_c_usage
constraints.description: If supplier B is used, supplier C must also be used.

constraints.name: tables_link_orders
constraints.description: Tables procured from each supplier equal the number of orders times tables per order.

constraints.name: total_tables_definition
constraints.description: Total tables equal the sum of tables procured from all suppliers.

constraints.name: usage_links_orders
constraints.description: An order count can be positive only if the corresponding supplier is used.

constraints.name: usage_links_tables
constraints.description: Tables procured from a supplier are zero when the supplier is not used.

constraints.name: supplier_usage_implied_by_orders
constraints.description: If a supplier receives any positive order, the supplier must be marked as used.

objectives.name: total_procurement_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total procurement cost across all suppliers

final_objective.description: Minimize total procurement cost across all suppliers by summing each supplier's per-order cost times the number of orders placed.
